conventions.marginal_endpoints: Descriptive marginal CI endpoint ratios; not calibrated ratio confidence intervals
conventions.shared_edges: A revision shared across edges is correlated; never an additional independent sample
conventions.selection: Recorded whole selected protocol per case. No pooling, filtering, recomputation, rounding or repetition substitution
conventions.rss_boundary: One isolated archived selected-case --test process: selected-case setup, same-case checked preflight, exactly one checked operation, complete output consumption/drop; no unrelated fixture/preflight; three paired processes and explicit macOS time -l byte peaks.
conventions.raw_summary_uncertainty: Criterion 95% intervals describe within-process median uncertainty. Between-process ranges/stdev describe independent process variability. Ratios of marginal CI endpoints are descriptive ranges, not calibrated confidence intervals for ratios. No performance disposition is assigned.
conventions.raw_summary_shared_controls: Each revision has three independent process repetitions. Edges sharing process records are correlated and create no extra samples. Equal numerical sample values are neither removed nor treated as reused process identities.
